    How iCoFyz works

    Getting started takes just a few minutes.

    Create your account

    Tell us about your store. Once you're verified, wholesale terms unlock across the marketplace.

    Discover and order

    Browse by category, value or location. Add products from many brands to a single cart.

    Sell and restock

    Receive your order, sell to your customers and reorder your favourites in a click.

    Import & Export

    Trade across borders, without the hassle

    With teams in India and the United Kingdom and trade links across Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas and Australia, iCoFyz helps businesses source, ship and sell products internationally. From finding the right supplier to getting goods cleared at the port, we stay with you at every step.

    Export

    Take Indian products to the world

    For Indian makers, artisans and manufacturers who want to sell to international retailers.

    • Reach retailers across Europe, Africa, the Americas, Australia and Asia
    • Guidance on product standards and labelling for each market
    • Export paperwork and shipping arranged with trusted partners

    Import

    Bring the best of the world to India

    For Indian retailers and businesses looking for unique products from international brands.

    • Source products from verified suppliers on every continent
    • Samples and quality checks before you commit
    • Freight, insurance and customs clearance coordinated
    • Help understanding duties and import requirements

    What we take care of

    Product sourcing

    We connect you with verified makers and manufacturers that match your product, quality and volume needs.

    Quality checks

    Pre-shipment inspection of samples and bulk orders, so what arrives matches what you approved.

    Export documentation

    Help preparing invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and other papers your shipment needs.

    Packaging & labelling

    Export-ready packing and labels suited to the destination market and the product type.

    Freight & logistics

    Sea and air freight options, including consolidated shipping for smaller orders.

    Customs clearance

    Coordination with customs brokers at both ends to keep your goods moving.

    How a shipment moves

    1. 1

      Enquiry

      Tell us what you want to buy or sell, the quantity and where it is going.

    2. 2

      Sourcing & samples

      We shortlist suppliers and arrange samples for your approval.

    3. 3

      Order & quality check

      Production is tracked and goods are inspected before dispatch.

    4. 4

      Shipping & customs

      Documents, freight booking and customs handled with our partners.

    5. 5

      Delivery

      Goods reach your warehouse or store, ready to sell.
